Container.Name: guncad-mirror
Container.Overview: GunCAD Mirror is a small piece of software that watches out for content on a GunCAD Index instance and mirrors it, offering it to the LBRY network for increased resiliency and redundancy.
Container.Requires: Ensure you forward ports 4444/tcp, 4444/udp, and 5567/tcp at your firewall/router to this instance. This app does not support UPnP punchthrough.

Config.Name: MIRROR_ENABLE_WEBUI
Config.Description: Set this variable to enable a lightweight web UI for monitoring.

Config.Name: MIRROR_API_ENDPOINT
Config.Description: The URL to the releases API endpoint of a GunCAD Index instance to monitor. The default value is the primary production instance, but you can configure this to point to a private/alternative/development instance. You can also add a query here to filter your results (ex. ?query=ar-15).

Config.Name: MIRROR_ASSEMBLE_FILES
Config.Description: Set this variable to assemble files. By default, the Mirror only stores blobs, as that's the native unit of reflecting a file back out to LBRY. If you'd like to have the files -- for your own archival or so you can automatically mirror them elsewhere, you can turn this feature on. Be warned that doing so DOUBLES YOUR DISK USAGE.

Config.Name: MIRROR_RELEASE_MAX_SIZE
Config.Description: The maximum size of a release (in bytes) we're comfortable mirroring. Any file above this size will be ignored. If unset or set to 0, this feature is disabled.

Config.Name: Forward Port 3
Config.Description: Ensure this port is forwarded at your firewall/router. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

Config.Name: Forward Port 2
Config.Description: Ensure this port is forwarded at your firewall/router. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

Config.Name: Forward Port 1
Config.Description: Ensure this port is forwarded at your firewall/router. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
